crypto_headlines.title: Strategy buys 811 more BTC
crypto_headlines.summary: Per an SEC Form 8-K, Strategy bought 811 BTC for about $65.5M between Oct 26 and Nov 1 at an average of $80,846 per BTC, bringing its holdings to 849,327 BTC. It also repurchased $208.2M in preferred stock.

crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin holds its $76K support as Binance sees $3.64B net outflows
crypto_headlines.summary: QCP says BTC fell to $76,141 on Friday after losing $80,000, but the $76,000 to $76,600 range held for a fourth time. Binance has reopened withdrawals across 15 networks after the exploit.

crypto_headlines.title: Elliptic: 44% of the stolen Binance funds are frozen
crypto_headlines.summary: Laundering of the roughly $6.43B taken from Binance has touched 11 blockchains, about 12,000 wallets and more than 40,000 transactions. About $2.85B is frozen, and the hacker has used CoinJoin for the first time.

crypto_headlines.title: South Korea orders exchanges to hold more in cold wallets
crypto_headlines.summary: After the $6.3B Binance hack, South Korea told its crypto exchanges to increase cold wallet holdings and bolster reserves, per Reuters.

crypto_headlines.title: BitMine adds 8,573 ETH, now holds 6.06M ETH
crypto_headlines.summary: BitMine's total reached 6,060,506 ETH, about 4.9% of Ethereum's supply, with 5,227,037 ETH staked.

crypto_headlines.title: ZachXBT flags a suspected $106M theft from an EU-based entity
crypto_headlines.summary: The on-chain investigator reported that an EU-based entity is suspected of losing more than $106M from multiple centralized exchange accounts on Nov 1.

doginal_news.title: Dog Pod creator studio debuts at DDMIAMI
doginal_news.summary: Kennel DAO says Doginal Dogs' new in-person creator studio, Dog Pod, debuts at DDMIAMI 2026, Dec 7 to 9, at Higher Ground in the Arlo Hotel.

doginal_news.title: HawaiiSol's lost dogs replaced
doginal_news.summary: Truck reports HawaiiSol says the Doginal Dogs crew replaced the dogs he lost, with the official account passing the word along.

doginal_news.title: Second Toot pulled
doginal_news.summary: Astro shared that he just pulled his second Toot card from Doginal Dogs Legends.

doginal_news.title: AK on bringing the Legends ARIA card to life
doginal_news.summary: AK shared the process behind the Doginal Dogs Legends ARIA card art and asked the pack whether to do another.

doginal_news.title: October Pyth Strategic Reserve report: 15.11M PYTH bought
doginal_news.summary: The October report on the forum shows 15.11M PYTH purchased through DCA by the Pythian Council under the DAO-approved OP-PIP-136 strategy.

doginal_news.title: Over 70 Pyth indices now live
doginal_news.summary: In a clip, Genia from Pyth Network says over 70 indices are live across equities, commodities, ETFs and metals.

notes: No new original posts from @DDLTCG or @PythNetwork in the last 24 hours; those items come from community accounts.
